alt: 城門外的旅人攤開空手，對面的守衛拿著長矛、腰間佩著劍。
scene_prompt: A calm but tense encounter outside an old town gate: three ordinary travelers in simple clothes hold both empty hands open and visible, without weapons, facing two distant uniformed guards carrying sheathed swords and upright spears. Clear unarmed versus armed contrast. No attack, wounds or gore.
